narrative_summary: Replacing an initial shell-script smoke test with a proper C# integration test project using mock fixtures for external dependencies.

kips.text: A shell-script-based smoke test was the initial approach to integration testing
The shell-script smoke test approach was abandoned after repeated debugging revealed it was unreliable
E2E tests were removed from the project
Manual E2E testing steps were documented in the README as a fallback after automated E2E removal
A dedicated C# integration test project was created and added to the solution as the replacement testing strategy
A BillbeeMockFixture was created for mocking external API interactions in tests
An SftpGoFixture was created for simulating SFTP file transfer operations in tests
Integration tests were created covering the SFTP client functionality
Integration tests were created for all four core sync operations: Orders, OrderFeedback, Products, and Stocks
A CsvTestData helper class was created for generating structured test data
Integration test warnings and code quality issues were cleaned up in a follow-up pass
